purpose: The Plan record types, each with its fields and its BaseVeda type address, and the one way to resolve a type from its id or any spelling of its address.
namedChanges: the one import, `import { BASE_ORIGIN } from "./config"`, is now `import { baseOrigin } from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-base-origin"`, and `BASE_ORIGIN` is read as `baseOrigin()`
in `baseHost`, the `try`/`catch` with the fallback host is removed, so it is `return new URL(baseOrigin()).host;`

the constant `RECORD_TYPE_BY_URI` (built at load from `typeUri`) is now the function `recordTypeByUri()`, which builds the same table from the same expression and rebuilds it when `typeNamespace()` changes; `resolveType` calls it
comments that name a host or `BASE_ORIGIN` are reworded, no code changed

0.1.1 adds `ALLOWED_EXTRA_ATTR_SLUGS` (lines 195-211), read from GilbApp commit a703b3ed78e612e2cab77e94876ce9bce109d5a3, where the file's lines up to and after the block fall at the same numbers as in the commit above; the only change is that the ticket tag `(VDS-10)` is dropped from its doc comment
